n1.speaker: player
n1.text: (Faelen calls it a perimeter survey. It somehow ends with two cups of bitter tea on the roof and the city spread below you.)

n5.speaker: player
n5.text: (She unfolds a hand-drawn star map. Half the constellations have no Earth names. Several are crossed out in red.)

n6.speaker: faelen
n6.text: These were watch stations. Each guarded a stable passage. When a seam changed, we knew before it became a gate.

n8.speaker: faelen
n8.text: The Wardens of Ilyr. I held the eastern line.

n9.speaker: faelen
n9.text: You said I did not have to hide that I cared. You were wrong. A Warden's attachments are routes an enemy can walk.

n10.speaker: faelen
n10.text: You waited for me to answer. I have discovered that silence becomes heavier when someone agrees to carry it with you.

n11.speaker: player
n11.text: "Refugees don't usually arrive carrying maps of the roads behind them."

n13.speaker: faelen
n13.text: When Ilyr's line broke, I followed the black-antlered host through the wound. The creature we killed in the street was one of its outriders.

n14.speaker: player
n14.text: "You've been hunting them alone ever since."

n15.speaker: faelen
n15.text: I have been finishing my duty.

n16.speaker: player
n16.text: (A gust lifts the map. You catch one edge; her hand catches the other. For a moment, neither of you lets go.)

choices.text: "You don't owe me the rest tonight."

ask1.speaker: faelen
ask1.text: The one that opened the eastern line from the far side. It did not stumble into our world. It tested the seal until it learned where to cut.

ask2.speaker: player
ask2.text: "You think something is testing Earth's gates too."

ask3.speaker: faelen
ask3.text: I think your gates are not weather. And I think I led one of the storm's hunters here.

space1.speaker: faelen
space1.text: No. But you are owed a warning.

space2.speaker: faelen
space2.text: Our seal was opened from the far side by something patient enough to study it. Earth's gates may be studied now.

space3.speaker: player
space3.text: "And you think it followed you here."

converge.speaker: player
converge.text: (Below, the house windows glow one by one as the others wake. Faelen studies them instead of the stars.)

n17.speaker: faelen
n17.text: I should have left after one night.
